messages:
jo: Quick heads-up: planning a staggered deploy tonight. runtime 2.4.1 -> api 1.9.0 -> router 4.2. Console has a schema/contract step tied to an api header swap (x-rdwd-v2). Window 23:00-00:00 PST. Any objections?
anika: No objections but we need strict sequencing. Console migration must be gated until api header is fully rolled and router confirms header passthrough.
rachel: Agree. Suggest runtime pinned, then api canary behind header-feature flag, then router. Console migration only after router health stable for 15m.
deploy-bot: deploy request received: runtime@2.4.1, api@1.9.0 (feature: api.header_v2), router@4.2. Scheduled 23:00 PST. Running preflight checks... :robot_face:
infra-bench: Preflight note: capacity on us-west GPUs good, but nvlink kernel patch not on 3 hosts (can still run). Recommend 10% canary first.
anika: Canary plan: api 10% for 10m, 50% for 10m, then full. If router p95 increases >150ms or system 5xx >1.5% we stop.
jo: Add console/schema-errors monitor: if console returns >0.5% schema-error we halt migration and flip api flag off.
rachel: We'll keep console behind FF (console.enable_migration) until router confirms. Also prepare migration rollback SQL script reindex-rollback.sql.
deploy-bot: preflight results: images signed, smoke tests passed for runtime and api, router smoke pending. Can start at 23:00 PST.
pagerduty-bot: oncall: anika (primary), rachel (secondary). Pager rules set for route-slo pages.
infra-bench: staging smoke showed a header parse edge when header contains multiple commas; patch in 1.9.0 handles it but we should watch logs: api.header.parse.warn.
anika: Noted. Add alert for api.header.parse.warn > 50/min to post to #eng-runtime.
jo: Rollback playbook (callout):
```
# quick rollback commands
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:2.4.0
deploy-bot rollback api@1.9.0 -> api@1.8.9
# unpin router if runtime failed
deploy-bot unpin router
```
Keep that in thread so ops can copy.
rachel: Also: if api canary fails, immediately disable feature `api.header_v2` (FF kill) and run router traffic backfill to previous variant.
deploy-bot: post-deploy hook: run migration-check (console schema verify) then e2e-smoke. If migration-check fails, mark deploy failed and auto-queue rollback.
anika: Logging/tracing plan: enable sampling=100% for api routes /v1/* during canary window for 20m. Ursula? (Ursula not in thread)
jo: Tagging infra: @anika will be lead for rollback call. @rachel owns console migration steps. Anyone on-call should notify #incidents on any page.
infra-bench: I'll seed dashboards for: api/header-latency, router/retry-rate, runtime/kv-evict, console/schema-errors.
rachel: Release notes snippet (will post once deploy finished): "runtime: KV perf and eviction improvements; api: header contract v2 (opt-in via FF); router: improved backpressure handling; console: staged schema migration (FF-controlled)"
anika: OK. Kicking at 23:00 PST. Keep all signals here and ping oncall if anything trips.
jo: Thanks. See you in the window.
